Game Overview

Neon Rider is a car game built around race through digital realms on your luminous bike, mastering intricate physics and razor-sharp reflexes. Let the thrill of collecting treasures and dodging hazards propel you across ever-changing, perilous tracks. Will you conquer the glowing challenges or crash and start anew? Every ride is a test of speed and skill.
